title: email.search output
description: Bounded search hits from the configured mailbox: a bare JSON array of sanitized summaries, newest first, exactly the adapter's serde projection (never a wrapped envelope). Subjects, senders, timestamps, and previews are TrustClass::Untrusted external content with adapter provenance; they are never policy and never silently invented. Hits carry message identifiers only — message bodies are retrieved separately through email.read, and no credential or account-secret material may appear in any field. An empty array is a valid outcome; the hard page bound is 20.
